001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.PumpFeaturesV2Response;
007
008import java.util.Arrays;
009import java.util.Set;
010
011/**
012 * The pump's Control-IQ feature bitmask: the value {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response} returns for
013 * {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex#CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES}, or 0 on firmware that
014 * does not support that index. It is fixed by the firmware, not by settings: 0 on t:slim X2 API 2.5
015 * and Mobi 7.6.0.3, 49 on t:slim X2 API 3.2/3.4, 3072 on Mobi 7.7.0.1 and 896 on Mobi 7.9.0.1 and
016 * 7.9.0.2. Across 81 records from 8 pumps it matched the live response in every session that
017 * captured both, and it changed only at the first boot after a firmware update.
018 *
019 * <p>Written at every boot, right after {@code ArmInit} and {@code VersionInfo} (on the X2, after
020 * opcode 312 as well), and in the block the pump writes after every {@link NewDayHistoryLog}
021 * ({@link VersionsAHistoryLog}, opcode 449, opcode 450, this record, {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog}):
022 * at midnight, after a boot on a new calendar day, after a log erase and after a date change.
023 * Older t:slim X2 firmware without PumpFeaturesV2 does not write it.
024 *
025 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 328 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
026 * app's history log list. Bytes 14-25 have been zero in every record and are exposed raw.
027 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
028 */
029
030/**
031 * History log record Control-IQ Features, opCode 328, size 26.
032 *
033 * <br>
034 *
035 * The pump's Control-IQ feature bitmask: the value {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response} returns for
036 * {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex#CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES}, or 0 on firmware that
037 * does not support that index. It is fixed by the firmware, not by settings: 0 on t:slim X2 API 2.5
038 * and Mobi 7.6.0.3, 49 on t:slim X2 API 3.2/3.4, 3072 on Mobi 7.7.0.1 and 896 on Mobi 7.9.0.1 and
039 * 7.9.0.2. Across 81 records from 8 pumps it matched the live response in every session that
040 * captured both, and it changed only at the first boot after a firmware update.
041 *
042 * <p>Written at every boot, right after {@code ArmInit} and {@code VersionInfo} (on the X2, after
043 * opcode 312 as well), and in the block the pump writes after every {@link NewDayHistoryLog}
044 * ({@link VersionsAHistoryLog}, opcode 449, opcode 450, this record, {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog}):
045 * at midnight, after a boot on a new calendar day, after a log erase and after a date change.
046 * Older t:slim X2 firmware without PumpFeaturesV2 does not write it.
047 *
048 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 328 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
049 * app's history log list. Bytes 14-25 have been zero in every record and are exposed raw.
050 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
051 *
052 * 
053 * <table border='1'>
054 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
055 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>328</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
056 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Control-IQ Features"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
057 * </table>
058 */@HistoryLogProps(
059    opCode = 328,
060    displayName = "Control-IQ Features"
061)
062public class ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
063
064    private long controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
065    private byte[] unknownTail;
066
067    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog() {}
068    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask, byte[] unknownTail) {
069        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
070        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, controlIqFeaturesBitmask, unknownTail);
071        this.controlIqFeaturesBitmask = controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
072        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOf(unknownTail, 12);
073    }
074
075    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask) {
076        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, controlIqFeaturesBitmask, new byte[12]);
077    }
078
079    public int typeId() {
080        return 328;
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * <table border="1">
085     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog:</caption>
086     * <tr><td><code>controlIqFeaturesBitmask</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td><code>unknownTail</code></td><td><code>Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 14, 26)</code></td></tr>
088     * </table>
089     */
090    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
091        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
092        this.cargo = raw;
093        parseBase(raw);
094        this.controlIqFeaturesBitmask = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
095        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 14, 26);
096    }
097
098    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask, byte[] unknownTail) {
099        Validate.isTrue(unknownTail.length == 12, "unknownTail must be 12 bytes");
100        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
101            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(328, 0),
102            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
103            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
104            Bytes.toUint32(controlIqFeaturesBitmask),
105            unknownTail));
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Only the low 16 bits have ever been set: 0, 49 (bits 0, 4, 5), 3072 (bits 10, 11) or 896
110     * (bits 7, 8, 9) observed.
111     *
112     * @return the uint32 at offset 10, the PumpFeaturesV2 CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES bitmask
113     */
114    public long getControlIqFeaturesBitmask() {
115        return controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * The bits of {@link #getControlIqFeaturesBitmask()} that pumpX2 has names for. The names come
120     * from {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType} and are not confirmed by this record;
121     * bits 4, 5, 7 and 10, which are set on some firmware, have no name and appear only in the raw
122     * bitmask.
123     *
124     * @return the named Control-IQ features in the bitmask
125     */
126    public Set<PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType> getControlIqFeatures() {
127        return PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType.fromBitmask(controlIqFeaturesBitmask);
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Bytes 14-25, all zero in every observed record (81/81).
132     */
133    public byte[] getUnknownTail() {
134        return unknownTail;
135    }
136}
